title: One-step hit probability recursion
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D>0$, and let $s,t$ be vertices. For every $k\in\mathbb{N}$, the probability that a uniformly chosen sequence of $k+1$ neighbor indices starting at $s$ hits $t$ is $1$ if $s=t$; otherwise, it is the sum of the length-$k$ hit probabilities from the neighbors of $s$, divided by $D$.
